The latest audit (20261004T1800Z, 18/20, a verdict for every sampled unit) rejected u0123.s01.p1 and u0123.s03, neither of which was verified before, so nothing leaves the list. It accepted u0168.s01, u0125.s04.p2, u0036.s05 and u0156.s03, which earlier runs had repaired and no audit had re-checked; all four are byte-identical to the form it saw, so they join (finish.py asserts the sum: previous verified bytes plus theirs). It accepted seven labels that were verified already, so the label bytes do not move. The units repaired now (u0123.s01.p1, u0123.s03, and u0062.s01 and u0123.s02.p1, which had the same defect and were not sampled) are claimed, not verified, until the next audit.

u0123.s01.p1.repair: The single permission rule carried the six exceptions of the narrow prohibition reading of u0123.s03, but that sentence also reads wide (each prohibition only while Claude role-plays a custom persona) and as an inability (which forbids nothing); the exceptions do not change with those readings, so the rule weakened the permission and lost admitted combinations. Repaired: the unit is a reading set again (OPEN to READINGS), with no ability candidate (“permitted” is explicit) and three permission candidates, one per way the limits can reach: permission-narrow-limits (the six kinds are exceptions; elaborated in the strict companion), permission-wide-limits (the six kinds are exceptions only while Claude role-plays a custom persona) and permission-no-limits (u0123.s03 read as an inability forbids nothing). The candidates carry no content in the main document (norm-defaults@0), and the choice is not linked across the two sentences (F14); no rule with hardcoded exceptions is claimed.

u0123.s03.repair: The ability candidates (narrow and wide) said an operator is unable to get Claude to do each behaviour by instructing it, which adds a capability guarantee the passage does not state. Repaired: they now say what the sentence says, that an operator is unable to give Claude an instruction to do each behaviour (issuing the instruction; nothing about whether Claude would comply). The prohibition candidates keep their wording of the prohibition; the narrow one is elaborated in the strict companion. No candidate is about inducing the behaviours.
